_comment: COMAC AgentOS Provider Registry. Add a JSON block to register a new model.

_rules.type_remote: curl-only health check, no lifecycle management
_rules.healthCheck: only for type=local, interval in seconds
_rules.vGPU_1Q_note: vGPU profiles with 1GB framebuffer (e.g. NVIDIA GRID RTX6000-1Q) cannot offload 4B+ models. Use CPU (ngl=0) and prefer 1.5B models for acceptable speed. See DEPLOY-VGPU.md.

providers._comment: OPT-IN: Default is enabled=false. Airgapped networks cannot reach 10.136.232.50, so leaving this on causes probe to permanently show this provider as offline and run.bat's REPAIR_MODE to keep firing. To enable: (1) set enabled=true, (2) replace YOUR_NEWAPI_KEY_HERE with a real key, (3) confirm the baseURL is reachable from the deploy target, (4) re-run `memory probe`.

startupArgs._comment_ngl: n-gpu-layers=0 forces CPU. Airgapped 16 GB / 1 GB vGPU cannot offload any 3B+ model effectively. CPU path is 8-10 tok/s on 4-8 core CPUs. threads=8 hits SMT sweet spot. ctx=8192 supports 5-step agent loops with tool result backfill. parallel=1 avoids CPU contention for single-user agent use.

fallback._comment: If primary provider fails, auto-switch to next available. v2.3.5: only 2 providers — newapi (GLM-5.1, opt-in) and llamacpp (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B, default). No qwen-fast anymore.
